statement: Let ~ be the equivalence relation on {0,...,n-1} generated by the undirected edges {allowedSwaps[k][0], allowedSwaps[k][1]} for 0 <= k < len(allowedSwaps). For an equivalence class C of ~ and an integer v, let cS(C,v) = #{i : i in C and source[i] = v} and cT(C,v) = #{i : i in C and target[i] = v}. For every input satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r and r = sum over all equivalence classes C of ~ and all integers v of max(0, cS(C,v) - cT(C,v)). Only finitely many v have cS(C,v) or cT(C,v) nonzero, so the inner sum is finite.
preconditions: Let n = len(source).
